verdict.rationale: Epic officially documents generating Python stub files (typed API definitions) from the editor's Python plugin so IDEs can provide autocomplete, and it backs this with a generated per-class Python API reference. That is real first-party machine tooling, but the documentation only covers completions, needs a manual Developer Mode toggle, and the Python API is marked Experimental. missing for 10: an official language server (LSP), documented diagnostics and code navigation via the stubs, stubs available without enabling Developer Mode, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent/editor attachment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the scripting language has first-class machine tooling — an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions a coding agent's editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation
